profiles.evidence: Wang et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 121 (2017), 12800-12806, DOI:10.1021/acs.jpcc.7b02957; clean Cu(110) UHV profile reports about 7% effective active sites for higher alcohols including ethanol. Active site density is derived from the FCC Cu(110) atomic density and that measured fraction. The nominal area is geometric, derived from a two-sided 0.5 mm coupon using Cu's FCC cell and molar mass; it is not a BET measurement. UHV surface data are not a direct ambient-pressure reactor rate calibration.
